描述_EN: after 1949, with the founding of the people’s republic, he settled in beijing and became director of the new central academy of fine arts and chairman of the national artists’ association. on returning to china, xu became a powerful force for the introduction of western art through his teaching, writing and exhibitions; his influence was rivalled only by liu haisu and lin fengmian. the work was made in summer 1944, shortly before the artist had a medical operation. horse is xu's favourite subject matter. it was given by him to miss ellen wilkinson (1891-1947), a prominent member of the labour cabinet in clement attlee's government. it was given to the v&a by her sister, miss ann wilkinson, after her death. xu beihong (1895-1953) was an important early pioneer in the introduction of western art to china and in the adaptation of it to chinese character. xu was born in a village in yixing, jiangsu province. in the period from 1919 to 1927, he studied at the ecole des beaux-arts in paris, acquiring a solid foundation in the western academic tradition. he studied painting in his hometown and shanghai before having an opportunity to go to europe. this painting reflects the artist's principal artistic concern, namely, to bring together the western academic tradition of painting and chinese aesthetics through ink techniques. as one of the most acclaimed painters and educators in modern china, he influenced the development of 20th-century chinese painting.
描述_ZN: 1949年后，随着人民共和国的成立，他在北京定居，成为新的中央美术学院院长和全国美术家协会主席。 on returning to china, xu became a powerful force for the introduction of western art through his teaching, writing and exhibitions; his influence was rivalled only by liu haisu and lin fengmian. 该作品作于1944年夏天，在艺术家做医疗手术前不久。 马是徐志摩最喜欢的题材。 它被他送给了艾伦-威尔金森小姐（1891-1947），她是克莱门特-阿特利政府中劳工内阁的重要成员。 它被她的妹妹安-威尔金森小姐在她死后送给了V&A。 徐悲鸿（1895-1953）是将西方艺术引入中国并将其改编为中国文字的重要早期先驱。 徐悲鸿出生在江苏省宜兴市的一个村庄。 在1919年至1927年期间，他在巴黎的美术学院学习，获得了西方学术传统的坚实基础。 在有机会去欧洲之前，他在他的家乡和上海学习绘画。 这幅画反映了艺术家的主要艺术关注点，即通过水墨技术将西方绘画的学术传统和中国美学结合起来。 作为现代中国最负盛名的画家和教育家之一，他影响了20世纪中国绘画的发展。
